title: Four-factor ordinary proper/open lambda component square
statement: For a commutative proper/open square and arbitrary ringed object M, system object N, and child comparison f from reduction(M) to N, the expanded pull/proper/open source map followed by the system properOpenLambda component equals reduction of the ringed properOpenLambda component followed by the expanded proper target map. This is the component square before substituting a recursive finite word.

source.place: Proper/open lambda coefficient-square expansion, four factors.

proof.text: Expand properOpenLambda and ringedProperOpenLambda into cartesian conjugation, restriction, clopen comparison and proper compositor factors. Apply the ordinary reduction square for each factor, using mate naturality and the unit/counit triangle identities, then paste the four equalities by associativity.

lean.statement:
theorem properOpenLambdaFourFactorSquare
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} (Cf : D.CoefficientDatum)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic Cf.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic Cf.l) E] (o : Operations Cf.l E)
    {S : Type s} (W : S → Scheme.{u})
    {a b c d : S}
    (k : W a ⟶ W b) (r : W a ⟶ W c) (p : W b ⟶ W d) (j : W c ⟶ W d)
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ j) (hk : IsOpenImmersion k) (hki : QuasiCompact k)
    (hjo : IsOpenImmersion j) (hji : QuasiCompact j)
    (hr : IsProper r) (hp : IsProper p)
    (M : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource Cf.l E (W a)))
    (N : coefficientSequenceDerived Cf.l E (W a))
    (f : (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus Cf.l E (W a)).reduction.obj M ⟶ N) :
    properOpenLambdaFourFactorSource Cf.l E W o k r p j hk hki hjo hji hr hp M N f ≫
        (IntegralSystemRealization.properOpenLambda Cf.l E o.system o.composition o.opens
          k r p j h).hom.app N =
      (IntegralSystemRealization.calculus Cf.l E (W c)).reduction.map
          ((IntegralSystemRealization.ringedProperOpenLambda Cf.l E o.ringed
            o.ringedOpens k r p j h).hom.app M) ≫
        properOpenLambdaFourFactorTarget Cf.l E W o r hr M N f
